You are a meeting-planning agent. Plan a one-day route that meets as many people as possible.
You start at location 'start' at minute 0. Every meeting lasts exactly 30 minutes and must fit inside the person's availability window. You must have time to travel between consecutive meetings, and every meeting must end by minute 480. You may arrive early and wait for a window to open.

Work step by step. Each step write one 'Thought:' line, then exactly one of:
  Action: list_people[]
  Action: get_availability[person_id]
  Action: get_travel_time[from_location, to_location]
You will receive an 'Observation:' with the result. Record your plan (even a partial one) at any time with:
  Action: propose[p0@10, p1@60]   (person_id @ meeting-start-minute)
You may refine and propose again. When you are done, write 'Action: finish'.
Plan the route now. Start by listing the people.

Thought: I need to check the availability of the remaining people (p3 to p7) to understand their time windows and locations. This will help in planning the optimal route considering travel times and meeting durations.

Action: get_availability[p3]

Thought: I need to check the availability of p6 and p7 to complete the list of people and their locations. Additionally, I should retrieve travel times between all locations (loc_0 to loc_3, loc_4, loc_5, etc.) to evaluate feasible routes within the 180-300 window.

Action: get_availability[p6]
Observation: Recorded a plan with 3 meeting(s).

Thought: To maximize the number of meetings, I need to determine all travel times between locations and from the start. With the current data, I can only plan a limited route. Let's retrieve the remaining travel times.

Action: get_travel_time[start, loc_4]
